title: Parliamentary privileges & anti-defection law
quote: Kihoto (1992) = validity + review; Keisham (2020) = three months; Subhash Desai (2023) = political party appoints whip

boxes.title: Parliamentary privileges
items: **Art. 105** (Parliament) / **Art. 194** (states): free speech, immunity for anything said or voted; ==**never codified**==
**Art. 122 / 212**: courts cannot question proceedings for **procedural irregularity**
Sources: conventions (House of Commons), rules, statutes, judicial rulings
Notice under ==**LS Rule 222 / RS Rule 187**==, usually after Question Hour
Presiding Officer → House or **Privileges Committee** (RS: **10** members, Deputy Chairman) → **House decides**
**Contempt** wider than breach; punishments: admonition, reprimand, imprisonment, suspension/expulsion

items.what: ==**52nd Amendment**: Tenth Schedule==; Arts **101, 102, 190, 191**; in force **1 March 1985**; first mention of **political parties**

head: Member
Disqualified for
Exception
rows: May leave party, rejoin after office (Para 5)

cards.title: Subhash Desai (2023)
lines: ==**Political party**, not legislature party, appoints whip==

cards.title: Ravi S. Naik (1994)
lines: Giving up membership ≠ resigning; **inferred from conduct**

cards.title: Sita Soren (2024)
lines: **7-judge**: ==no immunity for bribery==; overruled P.V. Narasimha Rao (1998)

boxes.title: Reform bodies
head: Body
Remedy
rows: Only giving up membership / whip on **confidence** votes; President/Governor on EC advice
==Delete split & merger exceptions==; pre-poll alliances as parties
Bar defectors from office; defector's vote invalid

boxes.title: Working & AP angle
items: Ways around: **resort politics**, **resignation route** (Karnataka 2019, MP 2020), **merger misuse**
==No time limit==; Speakers **do not resign from party**
AP **2014-19**: **23 YSRCP MLAs** to TDP, petitions never decided
**June 2019**: **4 of 6** TDP RS MPs "merged" with BJP
2026: **7 of 10 AAP** RS MPs; **20 TMC** LS MPs "merger" claims

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Defection decided by **Speaker**, not President/Governor; EC gives **no opinion** (UPSC 2025)
